note: Set A captures more genuinely supported facts — plate hole diameter and spacing, wood lag screw with washer, continuous sealant, grade-level elevation, and the 3/8" x 4" hex through bolt — with verbatim quotes. Set B duplicates the same frame/joist/bolt items repeatedly while omitting those facts, and it misbinds the 8'-0" and 1'-4" module dimensions to the A3 deck-module connection and fabricates quote text ("Detail A3: 3/4\" = 1'-0\" DECK MODULE TO CONNECTION", "3/4\" = 1'-0\" TYP.", "8 8D...", "OUGH BOLT"). Set A's main faults are misattributing the 1'-4 3/4"/1'-4"/1'-3 1/4" module segments to RAILING ATTACHMENT, calling 8'-0" a connection spacing, and an invented scaffold-footing-to-frame connection. On balance A is the more faithful and better-covered set.
